notes: 192 bars of 4/4 at 125 BPM is 368.64 s (17,694,720 samples at 48 kHz). The container is 368.664 s because of MP3 priming (1105 samples, start time 0.023021 s) and one trailing frame. Chrome decodeAudioData and ffmpeg drop that priming and land on exactly 17,694,720 samples, so loopStart is 0 and loopEnd is 368.64 s. The wrap step is about 0.0004, under a normal sample step, so no seam ramp is applied. No loudness trim: the true peak is -1.2 dBTP. Decoded stereo float PCM is 141,557,760 bytes. Only the selected stage's long bed stays decoded. A failed decode still falls back to the synthesised fight loop. Replaces verse_alien_electro_loop.mp3.
